scope: Read-only inspection of official Kestrel parakeet_tdt source at pinned commit; no local execution, no kernel equivalence, no oracle, no export

source.method: Public GitHub source read at the pinned commit; summarized contracts, not byte-copied sources

registered_identities.note: Redux and Ultra share ParakeetTdtRuntime and the same long-form orchestrator; Ultra verification can reuse this contract map.

features_contract.normalization: scalar per-utterance mean/std over valid frames only, eps 1e-5; NOT per-feature, NOT learned
features_contract.output: [batch, frames, 128] float32 plus [batch, frames] bool mask
nemo_deviations_to_verify: pad_mode constant vs NeMo reflect default
natural-log + 2**-24 floor vs NeMo log handling
scalar mean/var normalization vs NeMo per-feature Normalize
kestrel-local mel filterbank vs NeMo FilterbankMelSpectrogram (slaney conformity of kestrel mel asserted by its own docstrings, not measured here)

subsampler_contract.stageN: log2(subsampling_factor)-1 repeats of depthwise 3x3 stride-2 + pointwise 1x1 + ReLU
subsampler_contract.constraints: subsampling_factor in {2,4,8}; kernel 3; stride 2; mel bins divisible by factor

encoder_contract.blocks: conformer-style with fused ops delegated to runtime kernels (SiLU, GLU, depthwise conv+BN+SiLU, relative attention, fused residual-add+LayerNorm)
load_time_fusions: per-layer q/k/v concatenated into one QKV GEMM
all 24 layers' relative-position projections concatenated into a single Linear(hidden, num_layers*hidden); forward views [B, 2L-1, 24, C] and permutes to per-block rel_k slices
encoder_contract.relative_position: sinusoidal, inverse_frequency = 1/10000**(arange(0,C,2)/C), positions arange(L-1,-L,-1) => 2L-1 buckets, sincos stacked+flattened to dim C; activation-independent table
encoder_contract.activation_constraint: encoder hidden_act must be silu; top-level relu

decoder_joint_contract.decoder: LSTM(Embedding(vocab, dec_hidden), dec_hidden, num_decoder_layers, batch_first); inference cells concatenate weight_ih/weight_hh and sum biases to avoid CuDNN repacking
decoder_joint_contract.joint: Linear(dec_hidden, vocab_size + len(durations)) on relu(encoder_projected + decoder_hidden); token logits first, duration logits after; durations tuple strictly increasing from 0

vad_contract.presence: only checkpoints shipping vad_head.* tensors; attached before load
vad_contract.input: subampler output only (24 conformer blocks NOT run); per 0.08 s subsampled frame
vad_contract.output: sigmoid(logits.float()) speech probabilities + validity mask; purely local, block-stable

segmentation_contract.block_decode: 120 s blocks into a carry buffer, forward-only
segmentation_contract.speech_regions: prob >= 0.5; bridge gaps < 0.1 s; drop runs < 0.1 s; clip < 320 samples returned whole
segmentation_contract.cut_rule: midpoint of last usable pause before 30 s cap (prefer pause fully inside 1-30 s window, then pause midpoint in window, else exact 30 s cut)
segmentation_contract.overlap: none; no context margins (measured worse for the transducer); segments strictly contiguous
segmentation_contract.energy_fallback: 20 ms frame dB vs 2nd-percentile noise floor, +8 dB threshold; if p90 within 8 dB of floor the whole block is speech

kestrel_internal_graphs.kind: CUDA graph replay, not torch.compile/dynamo, not ONNX
kestrel_internal_graphs.encoder: capture model.encode_subsampled at buckets 48/80/128/224 subsampled steps, batch <= 16, eager fallback beyond; outputs cloned to caller
kestrel_internal_graphs.decode: single exact TDT step captured at fixed addresses (encoded frame index, decoder hidden, LSTM state); device-side duration table; budgets max_symbols_per_step/max_tokens; stop-signal lag 2
kestrel_internal_graphs.port_note: These are host-side performance structures; a faithful ONNX/WebGPU port maps the module contracts above, not these CUDA graphs.

kernel_boundary.delegation: fused matmul/activation compute and packed two-bit kernel rows delegated to kestrel_kernels; exact bit-order and activation arithmetic are NOT established from loader geometry
kernel_boundary.open_reconciliation: loader outer activation dtype vs docs/asr.md CPU int8 activation description requires an actual kernel/reference run

oracle_prerequisites_unchanged.blocked_on: user authority to install the pinned dedicated reference environment (kestrel-kernels==0.7.5, kestrel-native==0.1.9, x86 Torch>=2.8, Windows CPython 3.11 wheels exist on PyPI) without modifying existing NeMo/Qwen environments
first_approved_checks: exact-weight official oracle with pinned effective PCM, using Kestrel's own features contract above

limits: Inspection is of public source text at one pinned commit; upstream may change after this pin.
No Redux/Ultra weight was executed; no numerical, kernel, memory or speed claim is made.
The features-contract deviations listed are candidates to verify against NeMo behavior by measurement, not proven divergences for Redux outputs.
Ultra weights are not present in local caches (config snapshot only); any Ultra verification beyond this map needs download approval.
